info.name: Knowledge Graph Engine GraphQL API
info.description: Complete collection of GraphQL queries and mutations for the Knowledge Graph Engine. Includes CRUD operations for documents, graph schemas, Neo4j instances, requests, plus knowledge graph extraction, search, and RAG queries.

request.description: Login to get a JWT access token. The token is automatically saved to the {{access_token}} collection variable.

graphql.query:
mutation InsertUpdateNeo4jInstance(
  $partitionKey: String!
  $instanceId: String
  $neo4jUri: String!
  $neo4jUsername: String
  $neo4jPassword: String!
  $neo4jDatabase: String
  $containerId: String
  $status: String
  $maxConnectionPoolSize: Int
) {
  insertUpdateNeo4jInstance(
    partitionKey: $partitionKey
    instanceId: $instanceId
    neo4jUri: $neo4jUri
    neo4jUsername: $neo4jUsername
    neo4jPassword: $neo4jPassword
    neo4jDatabase: $neo4jDatabase
    containerId: $containerId
    status: $status
    maxConnectionPoolSize: $maxConnectionPoolSize
  ) {
    partitionKey
    instanceId
    neo4jUri
    neo4jUsername
    neo4jDatabase
    containerId
    status
    maxConnectionPoolSize
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}

graphql.query:
mutation ExecuteExtract(
  $partitionKey: String!
  $text: String!
  $graphSchema: JSONCamelCase
  $schemaName: String
  $documentSource: String
  $documentExternalId: String
) {
  executeExtract(
    partitionKey: $partitionKey
    text: $text
    graphSchema: $graphSchema
    schemaName: $schemaName
    documentSource: $documentSource
    documentExternalId: $documentExternalId
  ) {
    status
    partitionKey
    documentUuid
    schemaName
    entitiesExtracted
    relationshipsExtracted
    result
  }
}

request.description: Semantic similarity search using vector embeddings. Results include content and metadata with similarity scores.
LLM-generated Cypher query search. The LLM uses the graph schema to generate a Cypher query from natural language. Results are raw Neo4j records.

request.description: Vector search with custom Cypher traversal. First finds similar nodes via vector search, then applies a custom Cypher retrieval query for graph traversal.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation query. Retrieves relevant context from the knowledge graph and generates a natural language answer using the LLM.
RAG query with a custom prompt template. The prompt must include {context}, {query_text}, and {examples} placeholders.
RAG query with schema context. When schema_name is provided, the graph schema string is prepended to the query for richer context.
